title: EBU Stage D prospective completion-oriented continuation records
description: Authority schema only. No campaign, attempt, checkpoint, measurement, scientific outcome, result, or figure is created in this candidate.

prospective_negative_validation_cases.mutation: omit campaign_budget or attempt_watchdogs
set sealed_before_stage_f false or outcome_inspected_before_seal true
use attempt ordinal 2 when predecessor ordinal is 0
pair CHECKPOINTED_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED with a scientific disposition
pair TERMINAL_REJECTION_CAP with continuation_permitted true
pair CAMPAIGN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with a positive or negative scientific disposition
set continuation_permitted true for timeout, exhaustion, implementation failure, refusal, deadline, or infeasibility
omit cumulative ledger, stochastic next-counter set, cache epoch, invalidation epoch, authority, code, environment, topology, or exactness identity
use READY with attempt_index 1000000 or TERMINAL_REJECTION_CAP with another attempt_index
decrease a cumulative counter, reset attempt_count, or omit the predecessor ledger identity
count repeated physical bytes as new durable logical allowance
change any result-affecting identity or use suffix_equivalence_verified false
resume without transient classification, unchanged code/environment, proof of no accepted post-checkpoint state, or independent audit
mark infeasibility as scientific evidence or omit independent audit
terminalize while an attempt is active or omit the final campaign resource ledger
enlarge maximum n, subsets, hyperedge order, vertices, edges, depth, horizon, or another non-sliceable problem dimension
continue a partial atomic Möbius, poset, canonical, or exact-case operation
permit silent approximation, truncation, sampling, topology alteration, or arbitrary-N completion
omit, duplicate, or lose a terminal attempt delta; omit a latest run ledger; or make completion order affect the campaign aggregate
omit parallelization-boundary, worker-allocation-policy, storage-location, durability-policy, or restart-policy identity
change one campaign execution-policy identity without creating and digesting a new campaign binding and campaign identity
omit the embedded attempt_binding/v2 record or make its digest differ from attempt_binding_identity
change or omit a campaign policy identity, campaign/run/campaign-binding/ordinal/checkpoint identity, or policy-conformance receipt
make process_allocation_identity differ from the canonical embedded process_allocation/v2 digest
use a missing, duplicate, noncontiguous, or out-of-order worker ordinal; duplicate a process identity/index; or violate the frozen parallelization/worker policy
omit next_counter_tuple_set_identity
make next_counter_tuple_set_identity differ from the canonical permitted-stream and ordered-tuple preimage
omit, add, duplicate, or misorder a permitted stream id or tuple, or make the tuple stream-id projection differ from ordered_permitted_stream_ids
include TERMINAL_REJECTION_CAP or attempt_index 1000000 in a continuation checkpoint
use DETERMINISTIC_EMPTY with one empty counter array and one nonempty counter array
place a nonempty tuple under the canonical deterministic empty permitted-stream set
substitute a dummy permitted stream and matching tuple into an SD-01 deterministic checkpoint
change the deterministic canonical empty permitted-stream digest or empty tuple-set digest
use DETERMINISTIC_EMPTY with seed other than 0 or stochastic-rule identity value other than FORBIDDEN
make attempt_binding.policy_conformance_receipt_identity differ from process_allocation.policy_conformance_receipt_identity

prospective_non_evidence_schema_fixtures.purpose: Static schema-conformance fixtures only; they are not campaigns, attempts, checkpoints, draws, outcomes, observations, or scientific evidence.
